title: World tree myth of survivors climbing into the heavens

tellings.quote: Some of the stories like for example the the world tree where the great catastrophe comes and human humanity climbs the world tree

plain: Some old myths tell of a world tree that humanity climbs when a great catastrophe comes, a story the researcher Randall Carlson brings up with Michels without naming a source. He reads it as one of many tales that may carry a memory of a real ancient disaster and of people escaping it.
